name: Lantern release
summary: A night sky over the lake where each friend lets a paper lantern go with one wish for next year; lanterns drift and glow on their own, tap one to read its wish and warm it, or write yours and watch it rise off the shore.
useWhen: last night of the semester, everyone say one wish for next year
new year wishes for the group
something calm for the end of finals
let's do wishes before everyone goes home
dontUseWhen: new year plans with times and places (use midnight-route)
a recap of the year (use plans-map or wrapped)
goals with tracking and check-ins (use public-challenge)

title.description: Card title, e.g. 'Wishes for next year'

place.description: Line under the title, e.g. 'Lake Wren · last night of the semester'

wish.description: Their wish in their words, 36 characters or fewer

hint.description: Placeholder wish; used if someone lets go without typing
